mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a quarter signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a quarter signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real estate sales (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% each within a quarter signals a robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% within a quarter signals a tightening labor market with increased job creation, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases > 1% in 3 months
regime_hint: labor market tightening with job growth
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased by more than 1% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for more than 6 months signals a prolonged accommodative monetary policy, which encourages risk-taking and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was below 1% for more than 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a quarter signals deflationary pressures, which reduce consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.
